price_sensitive.description: Customer is deterred by price. High discount usage history, cart value significantly above their AOV, or signals of comparison shopping.
price_sensitive.flow_logic: Send 15% off code, expires in 24 hours. Subject line leads with the offer. Single email, no follow-up if redeemed.

trust_gap.description: Customer wants to buy but lacks confidence. First-time buyers with high cart value, or anyone who visited return/shipping policy pages before dropping off.
trust_gap.flow_logic: Lead with social proof (reviews, ratings). Highlight free returns, money-back guarantee, and secure checkout. 2-email sequence: trust signals first, then gentle cart reminder.

distracted.description: Customer intended to buy but got pulled away. Returning customer, normal cart value, short session, no policy visits. Low friction abandonment.
distracted.flow_logic: Clean, minimal cart summary. No discount, no pressure. Single email within 1 hour of abandonment. Subject: 'You left something behind.'

research_phase.description: Customer is still evaluating. Multiple product views, items added and removed from cart, low email engagement, longer decision window.
research_phase.flow_logic: Lead with product benefits and differentiators. Include FAQ, comparison vs. alternatives, and customer use cases. 3-email sequence over 5 days — give them time.

brand_context: Mid-sized DTC Shopify brand. Products are considered purchases ($80-$300 range). Customers are value-conscious but not purely price-driven.
